ms.promise:
Completion of integration for DEX Indexers including Minswap, WingRiders, SundaeSwap, VyFinance, MuesliSwap, and Spectrum.
With the indexed data, we can begin to work on a REST API to interface with the DEX data.
For this milestone, code to index DEX-related orders & liquidity pools updates. At the very least, a TypeScript project containing the 6 DEX indexers, along with data implementations to store the indexed data.
ms.criteria: Indexers to filter out DEX-related data for the following DEXs: Minswap, WingRiders, SundaeSwap, VyFinance, MuesliSwap, and Spectrum. The data to be indexed contains liquidity pool reserve updates, swaps, deposits, withdrawals, and zap orders. Along with these orders, statuses on their lifecycle must also be indexed. All of the indexed data must be stored relationally in a MySQL database to ease the development of the next milestone to produce a REST API.
